hero.title: Hi, I'm
hero.description: Systems Engineer with experience in web application development, Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and cybersecurity. I build scalable solutions using JavaScript, PHP, Node.js, Vue.js, React.js, and Cloud technologies such as AWS.

1.title: Cloud and On-Premise Infrastructure Lead
1.description: Experience working with more than 50 applications across Development, QA, and Production environments, contributing to deployments, database administration, and REST API integration. Implemented solutions using Docker, Docker Compose, Apache, Nginx, and AWS, complementing application development and operations with automation, monitoring, and cybersecurity practices.

2.title: IT Systems Assistant
2.description: Supported and administered enterprise platforms and databases used by more than 200 users. Automated processes using PowerShell and supported applications running on Windows and Linux servers, complemented by administration of VMware, Hyper-V, Active Directory, and corporate networks.

0.title: Inventory, Purchasing and Sales Management System (CVI)
0.description: Web application for comprehensive inventory, purchasing, and sales management. Includes product, supplier, and customer management, order processing, inventory control, and report generation. Implements CRUD operations, business rules, and centralized data management, focusing on the automation and optimization of commercial processes.

1.title: Music Social Network
1.description: Social network designed for music enthusiasts, developed to facilitate user interaction and music content discovery. Allows users to create and share posts, interact with others, discover artists, and manage content through a modern and responsive interface. The project includes authentication, user management, content management, and social interaction features.
